storyline.label: DeepSeek Pro
storyline.latest_title: DeepSeek releases official V4 Pro model as it steps up expansion - Reuters

prior_narrative.tldr: DeepSeek's retrained V4-Flash overtook the company's own flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks in late July. Two weeks later, a new "V4 Pro 0813" build quietly appeared on OpenRouter with no official DeepSeek announcement.
prior_narrative.whats_new: An early hands-on the day after that quiet Aug 12 build surfaced says the refreshed V4 Pro's multimodal capabilities meet expectations — DeepSeek's first confirmed signal that the flagship line is still moving.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: DeepSeek keeps shipping flagship updates through unannounced, API-only channels — pin the exact build you're evaluating rather than assuming "V4 Pro" is a stable target across benchmarks.

status.detail: A refreshed V4 Pro build appeared on OpenRouter with no changelog two weeks after V4-Flash beat the original Pro on agent benchmarks; an early hands-on the next day confirms its multimodal capabilities meet expectations.

beats.headline: Retrained V4-Flash beats flagship V4 Pro on nine agent benchmarks
beats.summary: DeepSeek's cheaper Flash variant overtakes the company's own Pro model on agent-focused evaluations.

beats.headline: A new "V4 Pro 0813" build appears on OpenRouter with no announcement
beats.summary: Simon Willison spots the refreshed Pro model listed API-only, with no DeepSeek announcement page to explain what changed.

beats.headline: Early hands-on says the refreshed Pro's multimodal capabilities meet expectations
beats.summary: The first outside impression of the new build focuses on multimodal quality rather than the agent-benchmark gap Flash had opened.

open_questions: Does DeepSeek publish an official announcement for the V4 Pro 0813 build, and what changed beyond multimodal support?
Does the refreshed Pro build reclaim the agent-benchmark lead V4-Flash took in July, or does Flash remain the stronger agent option?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Pin the exact DeepSeek build you're evaluating — "V4 Pro" now covers at least two distinct releases two weeks apart with no changelog — and re-run your own agent benchmark rather than trusting July's Flash-beats-Pro result to still hold.
